lines.t:
An {{effect}} that increases the <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> value (<c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c>)
that a <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{object}}<c> lost from taking an <c:ffff00>attack<c>, with
the initial value as the cap.

It is mostly an <c:ffff00>action<c> of {{part|pl}} with the <c:ffff00>Heal skill<c>.

The {{armor}} of a <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> {{part}} can't be recovered,
but the <c:ffff00>{{restore}}<c> {{effect}} works.
